title: Print-dialog page ranges with the edges tested
task: Implement `ranges.Parse(text string) ([]int, error)` in the spirit of a print dialog: `3-7` gives 3 through 7, `5` gives 5, and `1-3,8,10-11` gives all of them in order. A reversed range, empty text, a negative or non-numeric piece, and a stray comma are errors that quote the offending piece. Test the edges as carefully as the middle.
